# OutputFirst

> A bilingual journaling app for emotional clarity — designed for neurodivergent minds.

OutputFirst helps people build a daily writing habit by removing the blank-page barrier. Write freely, receive gentle AI reflection, and grow your emotional vocabulary in the language you're learning.

## Pages

- [/](/): Home — start journaling, browse tools, track streaks
- [/privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy and data practices
- [/auth](/auth): Sign in or create an account
